analysis.title: PrimeView: EU Performance Recovering; HFs Add to Neocloud Shorts & Hyperscaler Longs
key_insights: Following CRWV's results, hedge funds used the Neocloud rebound to add more than 1 standard deviation of shorts, citing funding concerns and Democrats' scrutiny of data centres.
Hedge funds added +1.7std to Hyperscaler longs, favouring higher-quality companies with established compute capacity and potentially lower policy exposure.
US Cap Goods was the most net-sold US sector. US Software was second most net sold (-0.8std for the week, -2.5std on Friday). Biotech saw significant de-risking (-2.2std over the week).
In Europe, Healthcare was the most bought sector, extending the defensive rotation underway since late October.
European hedge funds continued to sell the ex-AI economy. Low Quality and Cyclicals were the most net sold factors, with selling concentrated in Tech and Software.
Since 5 November, European L/S and Quant strategies have rebounded +2.1% and +1.4%, supported by Semis, Capital Goods and Banks, the three largest hedge fund net exposures in the UBS PB Book.
European strategies have recovered 75% of October's drawdown.
US and APAC strategies remain under pressure after a difficult October, though Quant performance has improved since 11 November.
